messages.subject: performing CIM
parts:
Hello,

I'm trying to run the CIM function using data created from the MSG pipeline (developed by Dr David Stern at Janelia). I was advised to use the Haley-Knott regression method, but I keep getting the following error message:


> BCM10.cim3=cim(BCM10.geno, n.marcovar=5, pheno.col="sterile", method="hk", window=10)

Error: BLAS/LAPACK routine 'DGELS ' gave error code -8
In addition: Warning message:
In checkcovar(cross, pheno.col, addcovar, intcovar, perm.strata, :
addcovar appears to be over-specified; consider dropping columns.

When I changed the method to "em", I get an output with identical lod scores. Has anyone else had this problem? Note that I've also had similar problems when I tried using the scanone function with my data.

Thanks for your help!
